Why Volleyball Clubs Order Factory-Direct

Club volleyball has an awkward buying pattern: several teams, several colourways, one club identity, and a season that starts before the budget clears. Buying through a dealer means paying a markup on each team's small run and waiting on someone else's production queue.

Direct manufacturing handles the whole club as one order - same pattern, different colourways, one artwork approval - including the contrasting libero jerseys that the rules require and that so often arrive as a mismatched afterthought. Twenty sets covers a team, and women's and men's cuts of the same design count toward one minimum. Test us first with a trial order, or browse the wider sportswear range.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom volleyball uniforms?

20 sets per design. Multiple teams within one club can share a pattern with different colourways, and each colourway counts toward the total rather than starting a new minimum.

Do you produce contrasting libero jerseys?

Yes - libero jerseys are produced with the team order in a contrasting colourway that still reads as part of the same design, in the quantity your roster needs.

How much does a custom volleyball uniform cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Comparable sublimated jersey baselines on our published pricing page run $18 per garment at team quantities, falling with volume; shorts are itemised separately.

Can you make women's and men's cuts of the same design?

Yes, from properly graded separate patterns rather than a resized single pattern - and both count toward the same 20-set minimum.

How long does a volleyball order take?

Free mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks, express DDP delivery 3-7 days.
